verdict.rationale: Keycloak's OIDC docs explicitly document the client-credentials grant for service-to-service (non-user) authentication, supporting client_id/secret or JWT auth and backing service accounts for machine-to-machine access, alongside token introspection/revocation endpoints for validating and managing these credentials. Realm/client management (via Admin Console, REST API, or kcadm CLI) lets operators provision and rotate these machine credentials without human login flows. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on report specifically validating client-credentials setup in production or AI-agent use cases.
